utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! Right, that thing... what day was it happening again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it's this Saturday, but I'm not entirely sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday... right, that sounds familiar. I should probably write that down somewhere or I'll forget by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Vik, what's this about a repair drive again? I think I missed the memo.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh hey Noah! Haven't you heard? We're having a neighborhood repair drive this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center—bring anything broken and we'll fix it together!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that sounds great! I've got a broken toaster that's been sitting in my garage for months. I'll try to drop by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the plan for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there, but I might not be much help this time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Why's that? Need a hand with something else?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal! I’m organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood this weekend—heard you’ve got a knack for fixing things. Want to help out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Fix things? Well, I’m better at knowing where everything’s supposed to go. Got a list of spots we’ll be working at?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We're hitting the old Parker barn, the community center's busted awning, and a few folks' sagging porches. Should be a blast!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Hana, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with tools or a hand setting things up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, thanks Sam! I could use a hand sorting through donations—some of the tools are pretty rusty, and I want to make sure everything's safe before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can come by this weekend and help sort through the tools. Got a wire brush and some oil to clean them up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, we're set to meet at the community center on Saturday morning, right after the farmers' market opens.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. I'll bring my toolkit and be there by 9.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo! I'm so glad you're here to talk about the repair drive. I have the sign-up sheet ready, and I was hoping you could help with organization.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I can help out, just tell me what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Bo! I was thinking you could coordinate the tool sign-ups if that works for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we start gathering donations, do we have a clear plan for how we'll transport all the tools and materials to the repair site?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good thinking. I can borrow my old pickup truck; it's not flashy but it'll get the job done.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief. How much can it carry? We don't want to make multiple trips.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, any word on when the repair drive is gonna start making rounds through our block?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven't heard anything yet — but I know Mrs. Gable mentioned they're fixing the potholes down on Elm first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Huh, good to know — I've been dodging that one on the corner for months, so I hope they get to us soon after Elm.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Kira! I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a stash of spare parts in my garage if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, seriously? You're just giving away parts without wanting anything in return?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, I'd rather see them used than collect dust. If it helps fix things around the neighborhood, that's more than enough for me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Jules, I heard you're working on a repair drive — need me to grab a tool from my shed?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That'd be great, Gus! I could really use a sturdy wrench if you've got one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I've got a heavy-duty one that’ll do the job. I'll grab it right now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Tess, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I need to check the school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, definitely! I heard the Andersons are bringing their old truck to help haul stuff, so we should have plenty of room.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that's great news! I was worried we wouldn't have enough hands, but now I just need to shuffle pickup duty with my partner.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Jules, I was wondering if we could swap pick-up duties this Friday? I've got a repair drive I need to help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, a repair drive sounds great! I'd be happy to swap pick-up duties with you this Friday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules, you're a lifesaver! I'll send you the details for pick-up and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's this repair drive all about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not entirely sure yet—I just know it's supposed to fix something important, but I'd like to look into the details before we get started.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: You mean nobody's actually told you what needs fixing? That sounds a bit backward to me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about this repair drive thing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely! I've already got three lawn mowers and a toaster oven lined up from folks down the street.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Three lawn mowers? Are you planning to start a landscaping business out of your garage?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo! I'm so glad you're here. I wanted to chat with you about the upcoming neighborhood repair drive—do you have a moment?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course, Rosa! I was just going over my supply lists—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful! I wanted to ask if you could head up the tool-check station—you're so good at keeping everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for organizing this, Leo. I'm glad we're getting the community together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure thing, Uli. Glad we’re making it happen.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there early to help set up, just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi, I heard you're organizing a repair drive? I'm new around here, so I'd love to know more.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes, the repair drive! I think it's this Saturday... or maybe next? I should check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hope it's this Saturday—I've got a broken toaster that's been staring at me for weeks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Noah, have you got any idea when Sam will be free to help with that drive repair? I'm swamped this week.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the drive repair? Sorry, I totally spaced on that. Let me check with Sam later today.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, no rush on my end, but if you hear anything, give me a shout. I'm in and out all week.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Sam, I heard we're organizing a repair drive this weekend—can I count on you to bring that old lawnmower you mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'll bring the lawnmower and any tools I have. Glad to help out!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Sam! I'll put you down for the lawnmower and tools—let me know if you need me to pick anything up for you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Gus, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're getting the whole block together to fix up the old playground!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds great, Quinn! I'll bring my toolbox and some spare lumber.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that's perfect, Gus! And I'll spread the word to the Smiths and the Lees—let's make this the best repair day yet!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries, Dane. I’ve got the route mapped out—we’ll hit Maple Street first, then the old warehouse district.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Opal. I'll grab my tools and meet you at the truck.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help distributing flyers?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would be great, thanks Ira. I have a stack of flyers you could take.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can pick them up later today. Where should I meet you?
